title: 第7章 见了鬼了
content_zh:
而且谷川费心费力，又不是为了赚钱，他是为了拯救中国的电影行业。

    如果能拯救这个行业的话，少赚钱也是可以的。

    他就是这么无私且伟大。

    谷川酒量不错，很快就把王中磊给喝趴下了。

    他针对的主要是王中磊，所以现在陆穿还只是迷迷糊糊的，没有醉倒。

    谷川说道：“把姜闻叫过来客串怎么样？”

    “你说谁？”陆穿一惊，连身上的酒气都散了好几分。

    “姜闻。”

    “你不要和我提这个名字！”陆穿气愤的说道。

    你还想看我被姜闻欺负吗？

    这辈子，他再也不会和姜闻那个畜生合作了！

    谷川小声的说道：“上次他和你闹的不愉快，现在外界对你的传闻可不好，说不定他能有点愧疚之情，就过来客串了呢？有姜闻客串，能加不少票房的。”

    “那个混蛋能愧疚？”陆穿‘呸’一声。

    他要是能愧疚，那当初就不会指着他鼻子骂了，还是当着剧组那么多人的面骂，是一点都没给他这个导演留面子啊。

    谷川笑了笑。

    他也不觉得姜闻会愧疚，但你上门去找他，他还能拒绝是咋的。

    客串，反正不给钱，多好啊。

    可惜陆穿死脑筋，不愿意去找姜闻。

    陆穿现在对谷川也有点不满意了。

    他感觉谷川变了。

    刚见面的时候，说的好好的，不影响他创作，剧组里都是他做主。

    现在合作达成了，投资也谈好了，事情就开始多起来了。

    先是想干涉他对男女主选角，后来又想让姜闻进组，这是一点点的蚕食自己啊。

    他想到了姜闻。

    姜闻也不是一开始就对他指手画脚的，也是慢慢来，先说一点小事，然后慢慢的，剧组的事情都是他做主了。

    刚开始他看姜闻是前辈，不好拒绝，没想到他一点没有前辈的性子，蹬鼻子上脸。

    这次他要防患于未然，不能让谷川成为第二个姜闻。

    谷川见陆穿不高兴，也不再多说。

    ……

    剧组很快就搭建了起来。

    制片人：谷川、王中磊

    王中磊只是挂一个名，偶尔查查账什么的，主要事情，还是谷川负责。

    摄影指导（摄影师）：曹郁

    曹郁是现在BJ最贵的广告摄影师。
content_en:
Moreover, Tanichuan worked hard not to make money, but to save China's film industry.

    It's okay to make less money if it saves the industry.

    He is so selfless and great.

    Tanichuan had a good drinking capacity and soon drank Wang Zhonglei to the ground.

    He was mainly targeting Wang Zhonglei, so Lu Chuan was still in a daze and not drunk.

    Tanichuan said: "How about calling Jiang Wen over to make a guest appearance?"

    "Who are you talking about?" Lu Chuan was shocked, and even the smell of alcohol on his body had dissipated.

    "Jiang Wen."

    "Don't mention this name to me!" Lu Chuan said angrily.

    Do you still want to see me bullied by Jiang Wen?

    In this life, he will never cooperate with that beast Jiang Wen again!

    Tanichuan said in a low voice: "He and you were unhappy last time, and the rumors about you are not good now. Maybe he feels a little guilty and comes over to make a guest appearance? Having Jiang Wen as a guest star can increase the box office a lot."

    "Can that bastard feel guilty?" Lu Chuan said 'bah'.

    If he could feel guilty, he wouldn't have pointed his finger at him and scolded him in front of so many people on the crew, which didn't save him any face as a director.

    Tanichuan smiled.

    He didn't think Jiang Wen would feel guilty, but if you came to see him, how could he still refuse?

    It's great to be a guest star, and you won't be paid anyway.

    It's a pity that Lu Chuan is stubborn and unwilling to go to Jiang Wen.

    Lu Chuan is now a little dissatisfied with Tanichuan.

    He felt that Tanichuan had changed.

    When we first met, I told him that it would not affect his creation and that he would be the one making the final decisions on the set.

    Now that the cooperation has been reached and the investment has been negotiated, things are starting to increase.

    First, he wanted to interfere with his casting of the male and female protagonists, and then he wanted Jiang Wen to join the team. This was a bit of a cannibalization of himself.

    He thought of Jiang Wen.

    Jiang Wen didn't dictate to him from the beginning. He also took his time, talking about small things first, and then slowly, he made the final decision on the crew's affairs.

    At first, he thought Jiang Wen was a senior and could not easily refuse. However, he did not expect that Jiang Wen did not have the temperament of a senior at all, so he scolded her.

    This time he wanted to nip it in the bud and not let Tanichuan become the second Jiang Wen.

    Tanichuan saw that Lu Chuan was unhappy and said no more.

    …

    The crew was quickly set up.

    Producers: Gu Chuan, Wang Zhonglei

    Wang Zhonglei only used a name to occasionally check accounts and so on. The main thing was Gu Chuan's responsibility.

    Photography director (photographer): Cao Yu

    Cao Yu is currently the most expensive advertising photographer in BJ.
